description: Makes an end user an app moderator or removes them, at once: moderators can approve and take down community entries and, in any room, delete messages, kick users and delete the room. Not access to your back office: that is neblla_team.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the test copy; it shares pro's moderators unless it has its own user data).

userId.description: The user's `_id` from neblla_list_users with the same env, not an email.

name: neblla_set_moderator
title: Name or remove a moderator
